tasks.name: Dual-Constraint Sessionization: 30-min Inactivity AND 4-Hour Absolute Hard Cap
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ordered_events AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id, 
        event_time, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rn
    FROM clickstream_events
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        rn,
        event_time AS session_start_time,
        event_time AS prev_event_time,
        1::BIGINT AS session_seq
    FROM ordered_events
    WHERE rn = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        e.user_id,
        e.event_time,
        e.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.event_time - s.prev_event_time > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
              OR e.event_time - s.session_start_time > INTERVAL '4 hours'
            THEN e.event_time
            ELSE s.session_start_time
        END AS session_start_time,
        e.event_time AS prev_event_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.event_time - s.prev_event_time > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
              OR e.event_time - s.session_start_time > INTERVAL '4 hours'
            THEN s.session_seq + 1
            ELSE s.session_seq
        END AS session_seq
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN ordered_events e
      ON s.user_id = e.user_id
     AND s.rn + 1 = e.rn
)
SELECT 
    user_id,
    event_time,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_seq ASC)::BIGINT AS session_id
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY 
    user_id ASC, 
    event_time ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH step_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS prev_time
    FROM clickstream_events
),
inactivity_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_time IS NULL OR date_diff('second', prev_time, event_time) > 1800 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_inactivity_break
    FROM step_lags
),
base_sessions AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        SUM(is_inactivity_break) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS base_sess
    FROM inactivity_flags
),
genesis_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        base_sess,
        date_diff('second', FIRST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, base_sess ORDER BY event_time), event_time) AS elapsed_from_start
    FROM base_sessions
)
SELECT 
    user_id,
    event_time,
    (base_sess + (elapsed_from_start > 14400)::INT)::BIGINT AS session_id
FROM genesis_diff
ORDER BY user_id ASC, event_time ASC;

tasks.name: Directed Dependency Graph Cycle Protection via Visited Array Path
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream AS (
    SELECT 
        child_task AS task_id, 
        1 AS depth, 
        ['BUILD_CORE', child_task] AS visited
    FROM task_edges
    WHERE parent_task = 'BUILD_CORE'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        e.child_task AS task_id, 
        d.depth + 1 AS depth, 
        list_append(d.visited, e.child_task) AS visited
    FROM downstream d
    JOIN task_edges e ON d.task_id = e.parent_task
    WHERE NOT list_contains(d.visited, e.child_task)
)
SELECT 
    task_id, 
    CAST(MIN(depth) AS INT) AS min_depth
FROM downstream
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY min_depth ASC, task_id ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream_graph AS (
    SELECT 
        child_task AS task_id,
        1 AS depth,
        ['BUILD_CORE', child_task] AS path_nodes
    FROM task_edges
    WHERE parent_task = 'BUILD_CORE'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.child_task,
        g.depth + 1,
        list_append(g.path_nodes, e.child_task)
    FROM downstream_graph g
    JOIN task_edges e ON g.task_id = e.parent_task
    WHERE NOT list_contains(g.path_nodes, e.child_task)
      AND g.depth < 10
)
SELECT 
    task_id,
    MIN(depth) AS min_depth
FROM downstream_graph
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY min_depth ASC, task_id ASC;

tasks.name: Exponential Half-Life Multi-Touch Marketing Attribution Normalized to 100%
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible_touchpoints AS (
    SELECT
        t.touch_id,
        t.channel,
        pc.order_revenue,
        POW(0.5, date_diff('second', t.click_time, pc.conversion_time) / (7.0 * 86400.0)) AS raw_weight
    FROM purchase_conversions pc
    JOIN touchpoints t
      ON pc.user_id = t.user_id
     AND t.click_time <= pc.conversion_time
     AND t.click_time >= pc.conversion_time - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
weighted_touchpoints AS (
    SELECT
        touch_id,
        channel,
        order_revenue * (raw_weight / SUM(raw_weight) OVER ()) AS attributed_revenue
    FROM eligible_touchpoints
)
SELECT
    touch_id,
    channel,
    ROUND(attributed_revenue, 2)::DECIMAL(10,2) AS attributed_revenue
FROM weighted_touchpoints
ORDER BY touch_id ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH weighted_touches AS (
    SELECT 
        t.touch_id,
        t.channel,
        c.order_revenue,
        POW(0.5, date_diff('second', t.click_time, c.conversion_time) / (7.0 * 86400.0)) AS raw_weight
    FROM purchase_conversions c
    JOIN touchpoints t 
      ON c.user_id = t.user_id 
     AND t.click_time <= c.conversion_time
     AND t.click_time >= c.conversion_time - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
),
total_weight AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM(raw_weight) OVER () AS sum_weights
    FROM weighted_touches
)
SELECT 
    touch_id,
    channel,
    ROUND(order_revenue * (raw_weight / sum_weights), 2) AS attributed_revenue
FROM total_weight
ORDER BY touch_id ASC;
